subject: Post-call: Redwood x Medora - security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping
messages:

Subject: Post-call: Redwood x Medora - next steps & stakeholder mapping

Hi Sophie / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Key decision criteria you mentioned
   - Predictable per-token cost + hard latency SLAs for patient-facing assistants
   - Private deployment option for PHI handling (VPC/on-prem review)
   - Integration with existing SSO + audit logging for compliance

2) Stakeholder mapping (please confirm / correct):
   - Economic buyer: Sophie Turner (CDO) — budget owner
   - Security / compliance reviewer: Jim Perez (Head of Security)
   - Procurement: procurement@medorahealth.com
   - Implementation lead: Ben Caldwell (Platform Eng)

3) Next steps (proposed):
   - Security kickoff / questionnaire intake (we'll have Marissa lead this)
   - Procurement checklist & pricing sheet (I will send)
   - Follow-up demo focused on integration options (Ben to pick dates)

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx (questionnaire intake for security team)

Could you confirm the stakeholder mapping above and share any additional people who should be on the security kickoff? If PHI/EHR systems are in scope, please flag them — that'll change our recommended deployment path.

Proposed security kickoff windows next week (PST): Thu 7/16 10:00–10:45am or Fri 7/17 9:00–9:45am. Marissa is copied and can pick the best slot.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the procurement checklist once we confirm the timeline.

—

Perfect — thanks Sophie. I've booked Thu 7/16 10:00am PST on our calendars (invite sent).

Ben — can you confirm the list of systems that will likely be in scope for the security review so we can tailor the questionnaire? Even a short inventory (e.g., AWS Prod account, Confluence, EHR integration) helps. I created a quick template but feel free to just reply inline.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@medorahealth.com>, Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@medorahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff — Redwood x Medora (questionnaire + scope clarification)

Hi Sophie / Ben — great to meet you (virtually) — I'm Marissa on Redwood's security team. Thanks for scheduling the kickoff. Below is what I plan to cover in the 30–45m kickoff and what I'd like to collect as an outcome so we can scope the review and estimate timing: 

Kickoff agenda (high-level)
- Introductions and roles
- Questionnaire intake review (responses + clarifying Qs)
- Systems & data in scope (EHR, S3 buckets, analytics pipeline, third-party integrations)
- Required evidence & timelines (SOC 2, pen test, architecture diagrams, data retention policies)
- Next steps and deliverables (remediation plan, security addendum / SOW)

Immediate asks (please):
1) Complete the attached questionnaire (Redwood-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx) and return within 5 business days.
2) Provide a short systems inventory (name, owner, whether PHI stored/processed) — I've attached a template (Medora-Systems-Inventory.xlsx).
3) Confirm whether you'll require Redwood to sign a DPA / addendum and whether your legal team needs any specific clauses beyond our standard terms.

Important for scoping: If any system in scope stores PHI (e.g., patient notes in your EHR), we'll need to discuss a private deployment path (VPC or on-prem) and additional compliance controls.

Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-report-2025.pdf (for reference)
Attachment: Medora-Systems-Inventory.xlsx (template for inventory)

I'll consolidate answers and follow up with a proposed scope & timeline within 3 business days after we receive the intake. If you'd like, we can also send an initial SSO/SCIM checklist to speed up integration.

Thanks — looking forward to working with you all.

—
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear agenda. A few immediate answers to help scope: 

- Systems likely in scope:
  * AWS Prod account (arn:aws:123456789012:account) — hosts API + S3 buckets with analytics exports
  * Epic EHR integration (third-party connector) — stores patient identifiers and notes (PHI)
  * Confluence + Jira (internal documentation & runbooks)
  * Auth: Okta (SSO) + SCIM for provisioning

- I'll fill out the Systems Inventory and return by EOD Monday (7/19).
- We will almost certainly need a DPA and data processing addendum attached to any PII/PHI handling SOW; procurement will follow-up on exact wording.

Attached: Medora-Systems-Inventory.xlsx (initial draft with owners)

Looking forward to the kickoff on Thu.
